outcome: clinician adherence to WHO recommendations for the prevention and treatment of maternal peripartum infections
finding: The prevalence of prophylactic antibiotic use during delivery in China was 52%, and clinician adherence to WHO guidelines was 79.9%, with significant variation observed across provinces and associated factors.
mod_finding: Prophylactic antibiotic use was strongly associated with cesarean delivery, while clinician adherence to guidelines was positively associated with cesarean delivery and negatively associated with operative vaginal delivery.
